verdict.rationale: Conta Simples documents a broad API covering corporate card listing and blocking, full virtual card (VCN) lifecycle, bills, balance, statements and reconciliation, categories, cost centers, suppliers, users and access profiles, receipts, and cashback. However, several UI capabilities advertised on the marketing site have no documented API counterpart: Pix, boleto issuance and payment, batch payments, the approvals area, the international dollar account, credit access, and AI spend insights. Corporate cards can only be listed, blocked and unblocked via the API, while the UI also issues them. Missing for 10: documented API endpoints for Pix and boleto payments, batch payments, approvals, international account and credit, corporate card issuance, plus any explicit parity statement or published OpenAPI spec.
